courier: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: original courier character directional reference strip on genuine transparent background. Carries small tan parcel close against torso with one hand while other is relaxed, NOT a huge box. Modern restrained original fine pixel art fitting warm Barcelona Stardew-inspired overhead RPG world, sharp pixel grid, subtle form shading, no realistic gradients, full body. Slightly elevated 3/4 overhead game character camera. Exactly FOUR evenly spaced poses in one horizontal row: facing SOUTH toward viewer, facing WEST to left, facing NORTH showing back, facing EAST to right. Same character costume and scale each cell, same feet baseline. Every pose static neutral standing, no ground shadow, no label or text, no floor, no objects except parcel and satchel. Large generous transparent margins, no overlap, each pose occupies separate equal quarter of wide canvas. Pixel sprite human proportions with head about one quarter height, readable face but not chibi oversized. Four separate direction reference sprites for game animation.

parcel_revision: Use case: background-extraction. Edit target: this small pixel art parcel. Preserve exactly the box design, parcel emblem, proportions, view angle, cream tape, blank label, crisp pixelated texture. Remove ALL brown glow, aura, blurred halo and surrounding shadow. Only the hard pixel silhouette of the box should remain. Outside its hard outline is completely transparent alpha=0, with no semi-transparent glow. Do not add or change any object. Final is one clean pixel sprite parcel cutout on genuine transparency.
